mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1% (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a deepening recession that triggers a flight to safety, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals a severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0 and INDPRO < 95.0 (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by housing starts above 650 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the following 60 days due to impending rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of periods when HOUST > 650 (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0 for 3 months) signals a supply shock that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 3 months (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL > 225.0 for 3 months) signals persistent inflation, leading to a monetary tightening that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.0 for 3 months (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 400000 million) and housing starts (HOUST < 630 thousand) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of periods when RSAFS < 400000 and HOUST < 630 (based on 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery (as indicated by INDPRO rising above 95.0 and UNRATE falling below 8.0), the S&P 500 tends to outperform in the following 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0 and UNRATE < 8.0 (based on 3-year rolling window).
